_readme: Hand-maintained manual overrides for team logos. NOT touched by the Python generation pipeline — edit directly.
player_season: overrides which franchise's logo represents a player for a given MLR season, for season/award-scoped
displays (awards page: major awards, Silver Sluggers, All-Star team, etc). Fixes cases where a player played for
multiple teams in a season (e.g. an All-Star selected while on their first team, later traded).
Keyed by player ID (string) -> season (e.g. 'S12') -> either:
- a plain franchise key string, applied to every award shown for that player+season, OR
- an object of award-key -> franchise key, with an optional "default" key used when no award-specific
key matches. Award keys match docs/data/awards.json's award codes (MVP, CYA, ROTY, RPOTY, GMOTY, BT,
everything else that season shows HOU).
player_default: overrides the logo shown on a player's own page header, independent of their stat history.
Fixes cases like a player who's shown representing a team they never had a stat row for (e.g. a GM credit
for a team they never played for). Keyed by player ID (string) -> either:
- { league, franchise, season }, matching the arguments to getLogoPair() in docs/js/utils.js, OR
- { image, light? }, a direct logo image path (relative to docs/, e.g. './img/mlr_logos/Foo.png') for a
one-off logo with no real team behind it. 'light' is optional (falls back to 'image' in light mode).
